_comment: Pipeline configuration. Modify values here instead of editing notebook code.

usage._tracked_activities_note: null = ingest ALL activity types. To track only consumption, set e.g. ["ViewReport", "ViewDashboard"]. Activity Events retains only ~28 days, so run daily to build long-term history.
usage._max_backfill_days_per_run_note: Caps days fetched per run so the initial ~28-day backfill stays under the admin API's tight tenant-wide quota (~200 req/hr). Each run loads the oldest uncaught days and advances the watermark; re-run until caught up. Set null/0 to disable the cap.
usage._access_note: Requires the 'Allow service principals to use read-only admin APIs' tenant setting, enabled and scoped to the service principal's security group.

extraction._comment: When incremental is true, only records newer than the last stored start_time per dataset are processed. Set to false for a full re-extraction.
